title: Detailed robot vacuum
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <!-- shadow under vacuum -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="82" rx="38" ry="8" fill="#1a2a3a" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- main circular body -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="58" r="30" fill="#4a6fa5"/>
  <!-- body top highlight -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="58" r="30" fill="url(#bodyGrad)"/>

  <!-- rim -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="58" r="30" fill="none" stroke="#7aaad4" stroke-width="3"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="58" r="27" fill="none" stroke="#3a5a85" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- top sensor tower / LDS bump -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="36" rx="10" ry="6" fill="#5a8ab5"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="34" rx="10" ry="6" fill="#6a9ac5"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="33" rx="6" ry="3.5" fill="#9acef0"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="33" r="2" fill="#e0f4ff"/>

  <!-- infrared sensor dots on tower -->
  <circle cx="46" cy="35" r="1.5" fill="#ff6b6b"/>
  <circle cx="54" cy="35" r="1.5" fill="#ff6b6b"/>

  <!-- front bumper -->
  <path d="M 28 68 Q 28 82 50 84 Q 72 82 72 68" fill="#3a5a85" stroke="#5a8ab5" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- bumper accent stripe -->
  <path d="M 32 72 Q 32 78 50 80 Q 68 78 68 72" fill="none" stroke="#ffcc40" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- LED ring on top -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="58" r="20" fill="none" stroke="#40e0d0" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.5"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="58" r="18" fill="none" stroke="#40e0d0" stroke-width="0.8" opacity="0.3"/>

  <!-- power button on top -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="58" r="5" fill="#2a4a75" stroke="#40e0d0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <path d="M 50 55 L 50 58 M 50 55 L 48 57 M 50 55 L 52 57" stroke="#40e0d0" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>

  <!-- side wheels visible -->
  <rect x="22" y="60" width="5" height="18" rx="2.5" fill="#2a2a2a" stroke="#555" stroke-width="1"/>
  <rect x="73" y="60" width="5" height="18" rx="2.5" fill="#2a2a2a" stroke="#555" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- front caster wheel -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="82" r="3.5" fill="#333" stroke="#555" stroke-width="1"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="82" r="1.5" fill="#666"/>

  <!-- side brush (left) -->
  <g transform="translate(25, 74)">
    <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="-8" y2="6" stroke="#ffaa40" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="-6" y2="-4" stroke="#ffaa40" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="-3" y2="8" stroke="#ffaa40" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="2" fill="#cc8830"/>
  </g>

  <!-- side brush (right) -->
  <g transform="translate(75, 74)">
    <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="8" y2="6" stroke="#ffaa40" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="6" y2="-4" stroke="#ffaa40" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="3" y2="8" stroke="#ffaa40" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="2" fill="#cc8830"/>
  </g>

  <!-- bottom brush housing (peek) -->
  <rect x="38" y="80" width="24" height="5" rx="2" fill="#3a5a85" stroke="#555" stroke-width="0.8"/>

  <!-- status LED lights -->
  <circle cx="40" cy="50" r="1.5" fill="#40e0d0"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="50" r="1.5" fill="#40e0d0" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- dirt/debris particles being sucked -->
  <circle cx="20" cy="80" r="1.2" fill="#c0c0c0" opacity="0.8"/>
  <circle cx="80" cy="78" r="1" fill="#c0c0c0" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="15" cy="76" r="0.8" fill="#c0c0c0" opacity="0.5"/>
  <circle cx="85" cy="82" r="1.3" fill="#c0c0c0" opacity="0.6"/>

  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="bodyGrad" cx="40%" cy="35%" r="60%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#6a9ac5" stop-opacity="0.6"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#4a6fa5" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
</svg>
